summary: Iteration 17 testing complete. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass for /api/cutting/materials-catalog (3 categories with 30/9/16 items + 51 rolls), /api/cutting/car-average (Mazda CX5, CX-5, cx 5, Toyota corolla, Tesla Model Y/modely, Chevrolet onix all resolved with correct promedios; NoExiste returns found=false), /api/cutting/car-averages (>=175 entries), and /api/seed/cutting-catalog (idempotent: 2nd call returns created_count=0, skipped_count=51; non-admin blocked with 403). Frontend: logged in as corte@polarizadosya.com, opened Completar Corte on a Mazda CX5 order; verified 'Promedio sugerido de material' shows 'Mazda CX-5: 1.51 m' and '151 cm totales'. materials-catalog-block visible with 3 tabs; tab-material-1 shows 30 items and 'Polarizados · 30 materiales', tab-material-2 shows 9 items and 'Seguridad / Ultrasecure · 9 materiales', tab-material-3 shows 16 items and 'PPF · Paint Protection · 16 materiales'. Selecting an item shows the cyan 'Seleccionado: XXX' badge; clicking the same item deselects (badge disappears). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: CuttingView.jsx is 1001 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the Completar Corte dialog and material catalog into subcomponents for maintainability.
cutting_catalog.py hard-codes 175+ car averages and materials lists. Long-term, this data belongs in MongoDB collections seeded once, so business users can update promedios without code deploys.
GET /api/cutting/materials-catalog and /car-averages return the same static payload on every call — consider adding client-side caching or ETag to avoid repeated large payloads on every dialog open.
seed_data_creation: Rolls were already seeded (51 items). test_seed_idempotent re-called POST /api/seed/cutting-catalog twice and confirmed idempotency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses 'access_token' (not 'token'). Cutting Catalog endpoints and UI all working end-to-end. Mazda CX5 sample order confirmed promedio 1.51m match via dash/space/case-insensitive normalize().
